version_scope.note: Official PDF page 32 documents ArrivalExpected and DepartureExpected in StopInformationRequest; exact official VDV-301-2.3 XSD contains neither field there, while both are valid members of StopInformationStructure.

semantic_basis.note: Pinned Common V2.3 page 32 visibly documents ArrivalExpected 0:1 and DepartureExpected 0:1 inside StopInformationRequest.
Exact official VDV-301-2.3 XSD contains neither field in StopInformationRequestStructure, but contains both in StopInformationStructure.

The V2.3 document history states that ArrivalExpected and DepartureExpected were added to StopInformation and references both StopInformation and StopInformationRequest sections, supporting a documentation placement error rather than a hidden request-schema feature.
EV-121 rejects either field in StopInformationRequest and accepts both in StopInformationStructure.

de.title: COMMON V2.3: ArrivalExpected/DepartureExpected stehen in der PDF im falschen Request-Modell
de.short: Die PDF führt beide Felder in StopInformationRequest auf; die offizielle V2.3-XSD erlaubt sie dort nicht, sondern in StopInformation.
de.long: Die offizielle Common-V2.3-PDF dokumentiert ArrivalExpected und DepartureExpected auf Seite 32 innerhalb von StopInformationRequest jeweils als optionale Felder. Die exakte offizielle VDV-301-2.3-XSD enthält beide Elemente jedoch nicht in StopInformationRequestStructure; sie gehören zu StopInformationStructure. EV-121 bestätigt die Grenze ausführbar: Beide Felder werden im Request abgelehnt und in StopInformation akzeptiert.
de.recommendation: ArrivalExpected und DepartureExpected in V2.3 nicht als Request-Felder implementieren oder als Alias akzeptieren. Bei einem entsprechenden XSD-Fehler auf die PDF-Platzierungsabweichung hinweisen und die offizielle XSD-Struktur beibehalten.

en.title: COMMON V2.3: ArrivalExpected/DepartureExpected are placed in the wrong request model in the PDF
en.short: The PDF lists both fields in StopInformationRequest; the official V2.3 XSD does not allow them there and places them in StopInformation.
en.long: The official Common V2.3 PDF documents ArrivalExpected and DepartureExpected on page 32 as optional fields of StopInformationRequest. The exact official VDV-301-2.3 XSD contains neither element in StopInformationRequestStructure; both belong to StopInformationStructure. EV-121 confirms the executable boundary: each field is rejected in the request and accepted in StopInformation.
en.recommendation: Do not implement ArrivalExpected or DepartureExpected as V2.3 request fields or compatibility aliases. When the selected XSD rejects them, explain the PDF placement discrepancy and retain the official XSD structure.
